title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Generative AI Engineer / AI & ML Specialist


We are seeking an experienced professional with 6–8 years of hands-on expertise in Generative AI, AI/ML, and Data Science technologies. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building production-grade solutions, implementing end-to-end Generative AI projects, and working across cloud ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement Generative AI applications using advanced methodologies such as RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, and fine-tuning.

• Develop production-grade AI/ML solutions leveraging cloud platforms like GCP Vertex AI, Azure AI, and AWS Bedrock.

• Work with structured and unstructured data to build RAG-based solutions.

• Integrate agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI) into AI workflows.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure API integration, test automation, and adherence to software engineering best practices.

• Optimize applications for scalability and performance in cloud environments.


Required Skills & Experience

• 6–8 years of experience in AI/ML and Data Science, including 2+ years in Generative AI projects.

• Strong proficiency in Python and frameworks such as Flask and FastAPI.

• Hands-on experience with deep learning, TensorFlow, and NLP techniques.

• Expertise in cloud AI services, preferably GCP Vertex AI, and familiarity with Vertex AI Vector Search, Gemini, Cloud Run, and Cloud SQL.

• Experience with agent-based frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph.

• Solid understanding of API integration, test automation, and software engineering principles.

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills.


Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

• Proven ability to deliver end-to-end Generative AI solutions in production environments.

title: Especialista de Barter
description:
RAINBOW DEFENSIVOS AGRÍCOLAS

Tudo sobre crescimento.



Somos uma empresa líder em proteção de cultivos que produz, distribui e comercializa Defensivos Agrícolas.

Somos a maior exportadora de agroquímicos da China e TOP10 indústria agroquímica global, presente em mais de 100 países nos 5 continentes, com 6 fábricas próprias e um time de especialistas focados em solucionar as necessidades dos clientes.


Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos profissionais comprometidos e que enxerguem na expansão uma oportunidade de construir e transformar.


Se você quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e contribuir para transformar o futuro da proteção de cultivos no país, venha fazer parte da Rainbow Defensivos Agrícolas.


  • Especialista de Barter


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Construir e manter relacionamento próximo com tradings e demais parceiros de Barter, garantindo alternativas competitivas de originação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de Marketing para desenvolver ofertas e campanhas de Barter alinhadas à estratégia comercial;
  • Apoiar diretamente o time comercial na execução das operações, desde a negociação até o fechamento do deal;
  • Analisar propostas, validar cálculos, condições, lastro agrícola e exposição de risco;
  • Garantir a acuracidade, integridade e arquivamento correto de todos os documentos (CPRs, contratos, termos, cessões, garantias etc.);
  • Monitorar o fluxo das operações no SAP, assegurando compliance com processos internos e SLAs;
  • Acompanhar o pós-negócio, garantindo aderência ao calendário de liquidação do Barter e Apoiar treinamentos internos e disseminação de conhecimento sobre Barter para o time comercial.



REQUISITOS:


  • Graduação em Agronomia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atuação prévia com operações de Barter, relacionamento com tradings, análise de CPRs e documentação contratual.
  • Conhecimento no mercado agrícola, culturas e produtividade, cálculos de equivalência (sacas), avaliação de risco, noções de crédito e compliance.
  • SAP e pacote Office (Excel avançado desejável).


DESEJÁVEL:

  • MBA/Pós em Agronegócio, Finanças ou Mercado de Commodities.
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Sr. Salesforce Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to augment the existing team and help accelerate delivery of a critical platform rewrite. This role will play a key part in shaping, building, and stabilizing a new integrated Salesforce-based platform, working closely with internal stakeholders and external partner teams.


Role Overview

The Senior Salesforce Developer will work alongside our partner teams, contributing hands-on to the design and development of the new integrated platform. This is a full-stack Salesforce role, with a strong emphasis on backend development, system integrations, and data modeling, as well as selective frontend work following established UI patterns and standards.


In this role, they will be expected to take ownership of complex features, contribute to technical decision-making, and uphold engineering best practices across a distributed development environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce backend components (Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, async processing) aligned with the ongoing platform rewrite.
  • Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions, including data modeling, integration patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Implement front-end functionality (LWC / Aura) by following existing design systems, UX patterns, and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven patterns where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with distributed teams, including India-based Salesforce developers and the Brazil-based Astra team, ensuring alignment and consistent delivery.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor less-experienced developers, and promote best practices across the codebase.
  • Ensure solutions meet high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Participate in our partner’s technical vetting, documentation, and formal code review processes.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement during the rewrite effort.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with deep expertise in Apex, triggers, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform limits, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience building and maintaining Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working within established front-end frameworks.
  • Proven experience working on complex, large-scale Salesforce implementations or platform rewrites.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and migration initiatives (GCP preferred, but AWS/Azure acceptable).
  • Experience working in distributed or staff-augmentation teams, collaborating across time zones and cultures.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
  • Nearshore location preferred (Brazil, Mexico, Costa Rica) to ensure time-zone alignment.
  • Ability to successfully pass a full technical interview and live coding assessment.


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Flutter or Go, which may be relevant for future product initiatives.
  • Experience with video/audio streaming applications or real-time collaboration platforms.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Salesforce DevOps tooling.
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architecture Designer) are a plus.


Why Join:

  • Work on a high-impact, end-to-end platform rewrite with a clearly defined launch timeline.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and technical leaders in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • Opportunity to influence architecture and engineering practices on a mission-critical system.
  • Fully remote, nearshore-friendly role with potential for long-term engagement and growth.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on a high-impact, mission-critical platform alongside senior engineers in a fully remote, collaborative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Sr. Salesforce Developer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to augment the existing team and help accelerate delivery of a critical platform rewrite. This role will play a key part in shaping, building, and stabilizing a new integrated Salesforce-based platform, working closely with internal stakeholders and external partner teams.


Role Overview

The Senior Salesforce Developer will work alongside our partner teams, contributing hands-on to the design and development of the new integrated platform. This is a full-stack Salesforce role, with a strong emphasis on backend development, system integrations, and data modeling, as well as selective frontend work following established UI patterns and standards.


In this role, they will be expected to take ownership of complex features, contribute to technical decision-making, and uphold engineering best practices across a distributed development environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce backend components (Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, async processing) aligned with the ongoing platform rewrite.
  • Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions, including data modeling, integration patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Implement front-end functionality (LWC / Aura) by following existing design systems, UX patterns, and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven patterns where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with distributed teams, including India-based Salesforce developers and the Brazil-based Astra team, ensuring alignment and consistent delivery.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor less-experienced developers, and promote best practices across the codebase.
  • Ensure solutions meet high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Participate in our partner’s technical vetting, documentation, and formal code review processes.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement during the rewrite effort.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with deep expertise in Apex, triggers, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform limits, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience building and maintaining Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working within established front-end frameworks.
  • Proven experience working on complex, large-scale Salesforce implementations or platform rewrites.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and migration initiatives (GCP preferred, but AWS/Azure acceptable).
  • Experience working in distributed or staff-augmentation teams, collaborating across time zones and cultures.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
  • Nearshore location preferred (Brazil, Mexico, Costa Rica) to ensure time-zone alignment.
  • Ability to successfully pass a full technical interview and live coding assessment.


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Flutter or Go, which may be relevant for future product initiatives.
  • Experience with video/audio streaming applications or real-time collaboration platforms.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Salesforce DevOps tooling.
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architecture Designer) are a plus.


Why Join:

  • Work on a high-impact, end-to-end platform rewrite with a clearly defined launch timeline.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and technical leaders in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • Opportunity to influence architecture and engineering practices on a mission-critical system.
  • Fully remote, nearshore-friendly role with potential for long-term engagement and growth.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on a high-impact, mission-critical platform alongside senior engineers in a fully remote, collaborative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - (SRE / DevOps) – Azure
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Você será parte de uma equipe de alta performance focada em garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura em nuvem global da empresa, com foco em Microsoft Azure . Atuará em um ambiente dinâmico, com equilíbrio entre projetos estratégicos em sprints quinzenais e suporte contínuo à infraestrutura produtiva , garantindo alta disponibilidade e segurança dos sistemas críticos.

Benefícios e Cultura

  • Flexibilidade de horários e trabalho remoto.
  • Programa de capacitação contínua (cursos, certificações, eventos).
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos com impacto real no negócio.
  • Integração com o Mantu Group , rede de empresas de tecnologia e consultoria com presença global.

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Job Title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)


Type: Full-Time


About Indigo Beam

Indigo Beam is a digital transformation consulting firm dedicated to helping organizations evolve their business through modern technology solutions. We partner with our clients to improve customer experience, reengineer operational workflows, modernize legacy systems, and unlock data-driven insights that power smarter decision-making. Our services span Content Management, ERP, Digital Modernization, GIS & BI, CRM, and AI—helping businesses not just react to change, but lead it.


Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope.


Project Management:

  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development.
  • Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed.


Microsoft DevOps Project Management:

  • Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies.
  • Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs.


Business Analysis:

  • Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams.


Client Engagement:

  • Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met.
  • Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements.


Technical Oversight:

  • Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards.
  • Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction.


Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development.
  • Prior hands-on development or coding experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts.
  • Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation.
  • Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope.
  • Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organization skills and mindset.


Desired Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset.
  • PMP certification and CSM.


Other:

  • The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions.
  • The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Informations:

  • Type of Contract: PJ
  • Hours: Full-time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Duration: Long-term

title: Especialista em Kafka & CDC (Debezium)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em Apache Kafka e Change Data Capture (CDC) com Debezium , para atuar na administração, operação e evolução de ambientes críticos de streaming de dados em produção. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas de mensageria e CDC.


Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar ambientes Apache Kafka em produção , incluindo instalação, upgrades, expansão de clusters e troubleshooting.
  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kafka em ambientes Kubernetes , utilizando Operators como Strimzi ou Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK) .
  • Gerenciar e automatizar deploys, upgrades e configurações via CRDs .
  • Implementar e manter soluções de Change Data Capture (CDC) utilizando Debezium , normalmente integrado ao Kafka Connect .
  • Criar, configurar, ajustar (tuning) e monitorar conectores Debezium.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e operação do ecossistema Kafka, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de boas práticas de streaming e CDC.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo remoto no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Técnicos – Kafka

  • Experiência prática sólida com Apache Kafka em produção .
  • Conhecimento de diferentes distribuições de Kafka:
  • Apache Kafka (open source)
  • Confluent Platform / Confluent Cloud
  • Kafka Operators (Strimzi, CFK)
  • Capacidade de avaliar vantagens e desvantagens entre as distribuições (lock-in, custos, features enterprise, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos fundamentais:
  • Partições
  • Replicação
  • Consumer Groups
  • Offsets
  • Experiência com Kafka em Kubernetes , incluindo operação via Operators.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação :
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares


Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC

  • Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC.
  • Atuação com Kafka Connect , incluindo:
  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento dos principais conectores Debezium:
  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e missão crítica.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a Kafka e Kafka Connect.


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade técnica.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e focado em excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e especialização em streaming e dados em tempo real.

  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kafka em ambientes Kubernetes , utilizando Operators como Strimzi ou Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK) .
  • Gerenciar e automatizar deploys, upgrades e configurações via CRDs .
  • Implementar e manter soluções de Change Data Capture (CDC) utilizando Debezium , normalmente integrado ao Kafka Connect .
  • Criar, configurar, ajustar (tuning) e monitorar conectores Debezium.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e operação do ecossistema Kafka, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de boas práticas de streaming e CDC.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo remoto no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Técnicos – Kafka

  • Experiência prática sólida com Apache Kafka em produção .
  • Conhecimento de diferentes distribuições de Kafka:
  • Apache Kafka (open source)
  • Confluent Platform / Confluent Cloud
  • Kafka Operators (Strimzi, CFK)
  • Capacidade de avaliar vantagens e desvantagens entre as distribuições (lock-in, custos, features enterprise, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos fundamentais:
  • Partições
  • Replicação
  • Consumer Groups
  • Offsets
  • Experiência com Kafka em Kubernetes , incluindo operação via Operators.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação :
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares


Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC

  • Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC.
  • Atuação com Kafka Connect , incluindo:
  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento dos principais conectores Debezium:
  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e missão crítica.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a Kafka e Kafka Connect.


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade técnica.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e focado em excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e especialização em streaming e dados em tempo real.

title: Data Specialist
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end-to-end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision-making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third-party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self-improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two-month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem-solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer


We are looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability stack, and platform operations. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure reliable delivery, stability, and scalability of our systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI.
  • Manage and evolve our GitOps workflows using FluxCD for Kubernetes deployments.
  • Maintain and enhance our Kubernetes clusters, ensuring reliability, security and scalability.
  • Develop automation tools and services using Python.
  • Manage and support a wide range of open-source services.
  • Administer and secure secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise platform performance and reliability.
  • Work across teams to enhance observability, logging, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Manage and maintain Linux-based environments and infrastructure.
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and support connectivity-related issues.
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and automation-first culture.


Core Technical Skills

  • Proven track record with GitLab CI for CI/CD pipeline creation and maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps tooling, ideally FluxCD.
  • Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on Scripting experience with Python.
  • Experience with open-source services such as, Elastic stack, Prometheus & Alertmanager, Fluentd, Kafka, Consul.
  • Experience with Hashicorp Vault (policies, secrets engines, authentication methods).
  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and container lifecycle management.
  • Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues (DNS, routing, firewall basics, TCP/IP) would be a positive.

We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. title: Site Reliability Engineer - (SRE / DevOps) – Azure
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Você será parte de uma equipe de alta performance focada em garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura em nuvem global da empresa, com foco em Microsoft Azure . Atuará em um ambiente dinâmico, com equilíbrio entre projetos estratégicos em sprints quinzenais e suporte contínuo à infraestrutura produtiva , garantindo alta disponibilidade e segurança dos sistemas críticos.

Se você é apaixonado por automação, observabilidade, arquitetura em nuvem e tem experiência sólida em infraestrutura como código, esta é uma oportunidade para impactar diretamente na transformação digital de grandes clientes do mercado.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar, analisar e otimizar o desempenho da infraestrutura em Microsoft Azure (clusters, redes, serviços de dados e aplicações).
  • Desenvolver, manter e escalar infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform em ambientes multi-região.
  • Gerenciar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions , garantindo entregas rápidas e seguras.
  • Atuar no ciclo de incidentes em produção , incluindo triagem, análise de causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis), documentação e implementação de correções preventivas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para otimizar arquiteturas em nuvem , promovendo melhores práticas de escalabilidade, segurança e custo.
  • Administrar e monitorar serviços críticos como Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway e redes privadas (VNet, ExpressRoute) .
  • Gerenciar e integrar soluções de observabilidade com Datadog , criando dashboards personalizados, alertas e métricas para clusters e serviços em Azure.
  • Apoiar a gestão de dados em Databricks , garantindo integridade, performance e segurança dos pipelines de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway, Networking).
  • Proficiência em Terraform para provisionamento e gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD usando Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions .
  • Conhecimento avançado em observabilidade com Datadog (criação de dashboards, alertas, monitoramento de clusters).
  • Experiência com Databricks e processos de data engineering em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ciclo de incidentes com foco em resolução rápida e prevenção de recorrência.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (leitura, escrita e comunicação oral) – necessário para colaboração com times globais.


Benefícios e Cultura

  • Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e com foco em crescimento profissional.
  • Flexibilidade de horários e trabalho remoto.
  • Programa de capacitação contínua (cursos, certificações, eventos).
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos com impacto real no negócio.
  • Integração com o Mantu Group , rede de empresas de tecnologia e consultoria com presença global.

title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

title: Especialista em Kafka & CDC (Debezium)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em Apache Kafka e Change Data Capture (CDC) com Debezium , para atuar na administração, operação e evolução de ambientes críticos de streaming de dados em produção. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas de mensageria e CDC.


Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar ambientes Apache Kafka em produção , incluindo instalação, upgrades, expansão de clusters e troubleshooting.
  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kafka em ambientes Kubernetes , utilizando Operators como Strimzi ou Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK) .
  • Gerenciar e automatizar deploys, upgrades e configurações via CRDs .
  • Implementar e manter soluções de Change Data Capture (CDC) utilizando Debezium , normalmente integrado ao Kafka Connect .
  • Criar, configurar, ajustar (tuning) e monitorar conectores Debezium.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e operação do ecossistema Kafka, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de boas práticas de streaming e CDC.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo remoto no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Técnicos – Kafka

  • Experiência prática sólida com Apache Kafka em produção .
  • Conhecimento de diferentes distribuições de Kafka:
  • Apache Kafka (open source)
  • Confluent Platform / Confluent Cloud
  • Kafka Operators (Strimzi, CFK)
  • Capacidade de avaliar vantagens e desvantagens entre as distribuições (lock-in, custos, features enterprise, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos fundamentais:
  • Partições
  • Replicação
  • Consumer Groups
  • Offsets
  • Experiência com Kafka em Kubernetes , incluindo operação via Operators.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação :
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares


Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC

  • Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC.
  • Atuação com Kafka Connect , incluindo:
  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento dos principais conectores Debezium:
  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e missão crítica.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a Kafka e Kafka Connect.


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade técnica.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e focado em excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e especialização em streaming e dados em tempo real.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner
description:
AWS-Python Production Support Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Seniority Level

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.
  • Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.
  • Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.
  • Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.
  • Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.
  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.

title: Data Specialist
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end-to-end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision-making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third-party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self-improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two-month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem-solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The Creative Project Manager orchestrates strategic brand and creative initiatives that drive institutional brand equity and enrollment outcomes while maintaining fiscal responsibility for project profitability and creative team accountability. This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management
  • Lead comprehensive project planning for brand and creative initiatives, establishing clear milestone maps that connect creative deliverables to client brand and enrollment objectives
  • Coordinate Subject Matter Expert (SME) resourcing across creative, content, multimedia, and brand strategy teams to optimize creative outcomes in partnership with Client Operations
  • Proactively assess and mitigate creative project risks, including resource constraints, approval bottlenecks, and brand compliance challenges, escalating issues to the Project Lead or Account Director to ensure proactive resolution and sustained client retention
  • Hold creative teams accountable for brand adherence, quality standards, and deliverable excellence through structured review processes
  • Financial Management & Resource Optimization
  • Track project revenue performance and burn rate to ensure creative projects remain profitable and within approved budgets
  • Monitor creative resource allocation and make real-time adjustments to optimize team utilization and creative project efficiency
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to maintain accurate forecasting
  • Cross-Solution Integration & Creative Workflow Leadership
  • Maintain strategic awareness of creative project integration points across solution project management campaigns to ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints
  • Collaborate with other solution PMs and the Project Lead to coordinate creative asset development timelines and shared brand resource requirements
  • Escalate creative integration challenges and brand compliance obstacles to Delivery Operations team for rapid resolution
  • Participate in cross-functional planning sessions to align creative initiatives with broader client marketing and brand strategies
  • Advanced Workflow Management & Quality Assurance
  • Manage Asana workflows for creative project management, including approval processes, version control, and comprehensive asset management systems
  • Implement and uphold creative quality assurance standards that exceed client brand expectations and industry benchmarks
  • Develop comprehensive creative brief and project documentation systems that ensure stakeholder alignment and creative accountability
  • Facilitate strategic client communications regarding creative strategy, brand development progress, and creative campaign performance insights


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of brand strategy, visual identity systems, and creative campaign development to guide strategic creative approaches
  • Proficiency with creative workflow management, brand guideline implementation, and creative quality control processes
  • Experience in project management methodologies with the ability to adapt approaches for diverse creative workflows and brand requirements
  • Advanced Asana administration, including creative-specific automation, approval workflows, and sophisticated asset management systems
  • Understanding of creative project P&L management and creative budget forecasting to maintain fiscal responsibility and profitability
  • Knowledge of multimedia production, content strategy, and cross-channel creative campaign coordination
  • Experience with brand performance measurement, creative testing methodologies, and brand equity assessment tools
  • Proven ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining brand consistency, quality standards, and team accountability
  • Strong collaborator, skilled at aligning strategists and creative teams, fostering open communication between platforms and specialists
  • Dexterity and wherewithal to effectively deal with campaign pivots, platform changes, and continuous optimization requirements
  • Demonstrates initiative and autonomy, effectively managing priorities while utilizing guidance and support when appropriate
  • Experience or interest in using AI tools, with a willingness to learn how AI can impact and appropriately enhance the client experience
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent life/work experience
  • 3-5 years of project management experience with increasing responsibility, including a minimum of 2 years in creative project management
  • Demonstrated experience managing brand, creative, or multimedia projects in professional services or higher education environments
  • Higher education or creative agency experience strongly preferred
  • PMP, Agile, or equivalent project management certification preferred


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team

  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
