Apoiar o comercial na condução de propostas e fechamento , com explicação clara dos honorários e estratégia. Direcionar o caso para o fluxo interno (triagem/produção/inss digital/judicial) e garantir transição organizada.
Alimentar corretamente o Astrea/CRM e Drive , mantendo histórico e rastreabilidade. Modelo de trabalho: tempo integral, regime híbrido, base em Salvador/BA , com possibilidade de remoto parcial. Qualificações Direito Previdenciário (essencial) Domínio em benefícios do RGPS : aposentadorias, BPC/LOAS, benefícios por incapacidade, salário-maternidade, pensão por morte, revisões. Capacidade de identificar tese jurídica, risco e viabilidade com objetividade. Consultoria e Atendimento (essencial) Habilidade para conduzir consulta com escuta ativa , linguagem simples e postura segura. Boa comunicação para explicar estratégia, etapas e documentos sem juridiquês. Perfil Comercial Ético (essencial) Capacidade de apoiar o fechamento com argumentação técnica e ética , gerando percepção de valor sem prometer resultado. Organização para lidar com volume, follow-ups e conversões com qualidade. Ferramentas e Organização (diferencial) Familiaridade com Astrea/CRM jurídico , Google Drive e rotina de registro de atendimentos. Noções de padronização de fluxos e checklists. Diferenciais Experiência prévia em consultoria inicial e conversão de clientes no previdenciário. Pós-graduação em Direito Previdenciário

title: Diretor (a) de arte
description:
Sobre a HIKE
A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira & transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.
Sobre a vaga
Você será responsável por liderar a direção de arte dos projetos de Branding da HIKE traduzindo estratégia de marca em sistemas visuais fortes, consistentes e aplicáveis no mundo real. Na prática, você é quem puxa a régua de qualidade do design, conduz rotas criativas, refina soluções até o nível máximo de acabamento e garante entregas impecáveis de design.
Nível do cargo
Sênior
Responsabilidades

Direção de arte de marcas: Liderar o desenvolvimento de sistemas visuais (identidades e key visuals), transformando insumos de estratégia (posicionamento, arquitetura, territórios, tom) em soluções visuais claras, proprietárias e autênticas.
Criação e evolução de identidades: Criar identidades completas (logo, paleta, tipografia, patterns, ilustrações, linguagem fotográfica e motion guidelines quando aplicável) e evoluir marcas existentes com consistência.
Packaging e design de key visuals: Desenvolver e/ou direcionar projetos de embalagem e key visuals.
Exploração criativa: Conduzir rotas criativas com clareza e repertório, testando caminhos antes de “fechar” a solução.
Padrão de craft: Ser referência de acabamento (tipografia, composição, hierarquia, cor, grid, micro detalhes), elevando o nível do time.
Gestão do time e/ou freelas: Direcionar e revisar entregas do time e/ou freelas, garantindo coerência com o sistema e nível de craft.
Feedback e iteração: Organizar rodadas de revisão (interno/cliente), filtrar feedback, priorizar ajustes e conduzir refinamentos sem perder o conceito.
Apresentação e defesa: Apresentar rotas e soluções com argumentação, critério e segurança; conduzir alinhamentos visuais e direcionar decisões.
Requisitos:
Portfólio robusto com projetos de branding (identidades e key visuals).
Experiência em conduzir rotas criativas e refinar soluções.
Domínio de ferramentas de design (Adobe CC).
Conhecimento sólido em construção de sistemas visuais.
Capacidade de traduzir estratégia de marca em decisões visuais (para além da estética).
Experiência em apresentar e defender trabalho para clientes, gerindo feedbacks com maturidade.
Nível do cargo:
Sênior I
Remuneração:
R$ 6.500,00/mês
Benefícios:
Caju (R$ 330/mês)
Gympass
Formato:
PJ
Modelo:
Híbrido (presencial 2x na semana)

title: Agenciador de imóveis
description:
Oportunidade Confidencial – Parceiro Comercial em Captação de Imóveis
Estamos em busca de pessoas que queiram crescer junto com um projeto inovador no setor imobiliário. Se você tem energia comercial, gosta de desafios e sabe transformar conversas em oportunidades, essa vaga pode ser para você.
Nosso time de parceiros comerciais atua diretamente na promoção da nossa marca, buscando também trazer proprietários de imóveis para locação para dentro da nossa plataforma . É um papel estratégico, com alta autonomia, metas claras e estrutura para quem quer gerar impacto e ser reconhecido por performance.
Como será sua rotina
Atuar na prospecção ativa de imóveis residenciais para locação, por meio de diferentes canais (portais, redes sociais, ruas, indicações);
Estabelecer relacionamento com proprietários e apresentar, de forma consultiva, os diferenciais da nossa proposta;
Acompanhar o processo de captação até a ativação do imóvel na plataforma;
Trabalhar com metas mensais de captação e indicadores de performance;
Contornar objeções e conduzir negociações com segurança, empatia e foco no fechamento.
O que buscamos
Perfil comercial, resiliente e com alta capacidade de autogerenciamento;
Excelente comunicação, organização e habilidade em negociação;
Disposição para abordagem ativa (ligações, mensagens e contato direto com proprietários);
Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e sistemas de CRM;
Experiência anterior com captação de imóveis ou atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial;
Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário local também é valorizado.
O que oferecemos Contrato como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) ; Ajuda de custo mensal e bonificações por desempenho ; Modelo de trabalho com autonomia e flexibilidade de jornada ; Não exigimos CRECI nem veículo próprio; Suporte estruturado com Jornada de Conhecimento, ferramentas e acompanhamento contínuo;
Acesso a um projeto nacional em expansão, com possibilidade real de crescimento.
Nosso compromisso
Aqui, valorizamos quem entrega resultado. Você terá espaço para atuar com autonomia, apoio para evoluir e reconhecimento proporcional ao seu desempenho. Se você busca desafios e quer fazer parte da transformação do mercado imobiliário, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.

title: Talent data analyst - remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.
Overview of the role:
We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.
Key responsibilities:
- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

title: Databricks qa
description:
Experience:5-8 Years
Key Requirements:
The resource should have a strong background in working with cloud platforms, APIs, and data processing. Experienced in AWS Glue, Athena, and Databricks.
AWS Glue Jobs: The QE should have familiarity with AWS Glue jobs for ETL processes. We expect them to validate the successful execution of around Glue jobs, ensuring that transformations and data ingestion tasks are working smoothly without errors.
Athena Querying: Experience with querying data using AWS Athena is a must, as the QE will be required to validate queries across multiple datasets. We expect the resource to run and validate Athena queries for data accuracy and integrity.

The resource should also have good knowledge on Boomi or any other integration tool like Mule Soft, Informatica, Talend, Workato, etc.

title: Ps systems engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U. S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.Key Responsibilities
Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.Skills & Experience
3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

description:

Business Unit: Graphic Communications
Location: Brazil, RemoteGraphic Communications( a CAI Division)is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries.Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. Reporting directly to theSr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.
In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.Key Responsibilities
Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities
Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify Java Script or API failures.
Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or c URL.
Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP. NET-based applications and related components.
Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.Experience Requirements
Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
ERP/MIS background preferred.
Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
Willing to work in shifts as required.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.Education
Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Especialista azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.Oportunidade: Especialista Azure
A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataformaMicrosoft Azure. A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase emAzure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.Responsabilidades
Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou Express Route.
Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.
Requisitos Técnicos
Domínio comprovado emAzure Network(mandatório).
Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.Contratação CLT
Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.O que oferecemos?· Contratação CLT;
· Vale Refeição;
· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
· Auxílio creche;
· Convênio com Farmácia;
· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
· Seguro de Vida.O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

description:

We're a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup reinventing how medical practices capture revenue. Backed by experienced founders and already live with our first client, we're building AI-driven tools that automate clinical documentation, coding, and billing — helping clinics recover revenue and improve care.

Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform

SQL + data modeling
Experience with streaming, queues, or event-driven systems
Startup mindset: autonomy, speed, ownershipNice-to-haves
Go or Python
Clean architecture / DDD
AI/ML or LLM pipeline experience
Healthcare tech (EHR, RCM)
HIPAA / PHI security
HL7/FHIR/X12Why join us
Build meaningful, mission-critical healthcare AI
Work with a small, high-caliber founding team
Competitive comp + meaningful ownership
Flexible, modern work environment

title: Cloud platform developer
description:
Important Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary
We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.Responsibilities and Duties
Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5 G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.Essential Skills
Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
How to work on the command line and with files;
How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
How to create and run simple scripts;
Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Docker;
Experience with Helm.Highly Desirable Skills
Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Postgre SQL as a developer;
Experience with Rabbit MQ as a developer.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack(go e java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel
Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.
Visão geral do cargo
E stamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou plenopara projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.
O que você fará
• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).
• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.
• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).
• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.
• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.
• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.
Requisitos mandatorios:
• Sólida experiência com Golang.
• Experiência com Java 8+.
• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, Cloud Watch, IAM, etc.).
• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).
• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.
• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.
Diferenciais
• Experiencia com framework quarkus.
• Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Cloud Formation).
• Proficiência ou conhecimento prático de Python (scripts de automação, módulos, microsserviços).
• Experiência de trabalho em ambientes de alta criticidade ou alta disponibilidade.
• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.

title: Latam business development representative
description:
About Prometheus Group
Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results-focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.Job Summary
Do you love the thrill of victory? Are you interested in a path to success? Then the Business Development Representative role at Prometheus Group is your job! Business Development Representatives immediately affect the overall pipeline and growth of our company. With the advanced sales tactics that we institute, you will not only be an integral part of our sales process but also contribute to our overall bottom line. The Business Development Representative role is the backbone of our successful LATAM sales team, and we want you to be a part of that!At Prometheus Group, we live and breathe off a meritocracy-based promotion system. Promotions are not based on tenure but based on the ability & talent you possess within this role. Business Development Representatives will have opportunities to progress into different paths, such as Account Management or Team Management.Your role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential clients, so ambition is a top priority when looking for the perfect candidate. You will use your communication skills to cultivate strong relationships with prospects from the first contact until you qualify the opportunity. Do you think you have what it takes? Submit your resume today!Responsibilities
Maintain high call volume daily (80-100 calls)
Develop leads in cold and warm prospect accounts to generate interest in our solutions.
Gather prospects' needs and understand their initiatives related to our solutions.
Discover new software opportunities by calling targeted prospect accounts
Generate a steady flow of qualified opportunities each month
Develop and deliver high-level product presentations to new clients.
Participate in the development of accounts, prospect profiling, and sales cycles.
Collaborate with experienced account managers when prospecting accounts and creating opportunities.Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree
Fluent in Spanish and Portuguese
High-energy self-starter who can learn quickly and engage clients
1+ years of cold calling experience preferred
Ambition to grow and build a career in sales
Ability to resonate with the prospect's situation and detect needs
Positive and energetic phone skills
Customer-focused, results-driven with excellent interpersonal skills
Salesforce experience is a plusPrometheus Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Executive search consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:
Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.About the Role
We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.WHAT YOU WILL DOCandidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)
Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
Passive search: Source, screen applicants
Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessmentEnd to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)
Build and manage candidate pipeline
Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
Support client communications and progress check-ins.
Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.Business Development Support (10%)
Research companies, markets, and potential clients
Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the companyIDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.
O que você fará
• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).
• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.
• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).
• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.
• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.
• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.
Requisitos mandatorios:
• Sólida experiência com Golang.
• Experiência com Java 8+.
• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, Cloud Watch, IAM, etc.).
• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).
• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.
• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.
Diferenciais
• Experiencia com framework quarkus.

• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.

title: Business developer for social media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.Key Responsibilities:
Identify high-revenue potential You Tube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic prioritiesIdeal Candidate Profile:
Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainmentIf you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!

description:

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, Java Script, Type Script, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4 HANA system etc.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features
Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic
Use S/4 HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4 HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4 HANA system.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues
Provide sufficient documentations on features developed
Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Participate in daily scrums

Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.
Maintain communication and documentation in English

title: 11072 - técnico em refrigeração
description:
Estamos buscando um Técnico em Refrigeração, para multinacional do segmento de refrigeração/climatização, que fará manutenção e reparo em sistemas de refrigeração e climatização, em conformidade com os contratos estabelecidos com os clientes! ✨

Formação Técnica completa em Mecânica de Refrigeração e Climatização, Eletrotécnico, Eletromecânica, Climatização, etc;
Conhecimentos em princípios de refrigeração, diagnóstico, manutenção, normas ambientais, sistemas de controle e segurança;
Alguma experiência prévia em Chiller (sistema de água gelada);
Diferencial conhecedor de equipamentos Carrier, Daikin, Traner ou York;
Conhecimento em Pacote Office, em especial Excel;
Desejável inglês intermediário/técnico (leitura e escrita).

CNH - Categoria B;
Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (podendo permanecer até 15 dias fora da base).

Atender às demandas de manutenção referente ao Ar-Condicionado de clientes;
Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos, garantindo a eficiência e o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos, com suporte de profissionais mais experientes;
Elaborar relatórios detalhados utilizando o software de manutenção, registrando todas as atividades realizadas e o estado dos equipamentos;

title: Senior manager, regional key account management
description:
This position will be accountable for managing, directing and leading the CEVA Logistics programs for BYD across the LATAM region.

Key Accountabilities
1
Ability to understand unique customer supply chain requirements and drive a particular sector focus
2
Identify business opportunities that add value to BYD logistics programs whilst generating business leads that meet and exceed business goals
3
Expansion/Growth is mission critical to the role. Senior relationship management and service execution are two key components to insure account expansion/growth is achieved
4
Retention is key to grow portfolio of business across all product/service types within CEVA
5
Drive collaborative efforts between country and multiple product leaders within CEVA to meet the needs of customers
6
Prospecting for all products opportunities and delivering compelling solutions, value and pricing
7
Maintain an Account Plan for the customer that will encompass a strategic roadmap defining multi-year growth, targets by key supply chain
8
Execute Account Plans (forecasts, budgets and operating plans)
9
Ability to work in a matrix organization along with virtual teams & build strong internal relationships with Sponsor/Global/Regional/Sector team leaders as required for the account
10
Build strategic relationships with key contacts within customer organizations to understand opportunities for creating value
11
Stay aligned and team work with GKAM and other region RKAMs
12
Conduct regular business review meetings with customers and drive meeting content to ensure operations, support and execution teams are present to support these reviews
13
Responsible to communicate all expectations on these review meetings to the operations and support teams for implementation or improvements
14
Lead & create innovation solution with team based on deep understanding of business streams of customer
15
Leverage on Sectors Focused Solutions to penetrate account growth and development (Eg. Use of case studies and key SMART solutions within CEVA)
16
Work with implementation teams on new projects to ensure customer expectations are communicated
17
Lead and work with customer to resolve all contractual and commercial decisions in compliance with CEVA policies and terms
18
Continue cross selling within CEVA and CMA CGM group to maximize biz portfolio for the group
19
Accurate and timely update of all customer engagement activities and business development opportunities within C-View
20
Need to support other China-Brazil sales leads and Chinese projects/business
Requirements

Minimum 10 years industry experience.
Minimum 8 years account management managerial and/or customer relationship management experience required.
Bachelor degree holder majoring in supply chain/logistics/ /transportation management/sales and marketing/international business
In-depth knowledge of all air,sea, ground and contract logistics products and services.
Excellent planning, time management, collaboration, decision making, organization, presentation and negotiating skills.
Strong background in sales and marketing and a proven track recordin business development and growth.
Demonstrated success in managing (KPI’s) Key Performance Indicators.
Demonstrated success in problem solving through use of data and information metrics and improvement to performance process.
Proficient in project management methodologies with a focus on managing solution driven strategy plans to achieve goals.
Experienced in financial management (P& L's, Balance Sheets,forecasting and budgets) to effectuate return on investment.
Manages complex or emotional customer situations promptly andprofessionally meeting commitments for service and assistance.
Maintains stable performance underpressure or opposition; handling stress in a mannerthat is acceptable to others and the organization.
Uses appropriate methods and a flexible interpersonal style to help build a cohesive teamand facilitates the completion of team goals.
Excellent presentation skills.
Fluent in both Chinese and English
Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook);

title: Data analyst
description:
Título do Cargo:Analista de Dados
Nível:4 ou 5O que você fará:
Ter mentalidade de crescimento, identificando desafios e oportunidades de negócio e resolvendo-os por meio de análise e mineração de dados.
Apoiar análises e fornecer insights sobre uso de produto, performance de campanhas, métricas de funil, segmentação, conversão e crescimento de receita.
Desenvolver análises ad-hoc, projetos de longo prazo, relatórios e dashboards para gerar novos insights e medir o progresso das iniciativas-chave.
Trabalhar em conjunto com stakeholders para entender necessidades analíticas, métricas críticas e KPIs.
Colaborar com diferentes times da organização para compreender requisitos e necessidades de negócio.
Criar e apresentar análises que traduzam problemas complexos em insights claros e acionáveis.Requisitos Mínimos:
Graduação ou nível superior em área quantitativa.
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em funções de análise de dados.
Mais de 3 anos de experiência com Python, SQL e ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Looker ou Power BI.
Histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão e resolução de problemas baseada em dados.
Forte visão de negócio, liderança e integridade.
Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de influência estratégica e negociação.
Perfil proativo, adaptável e confortável em ambientes dinâmicos.
Forte domínio de ferramentas de BI e Excel (Power BI é um diferencial).Diferenciais:
Experiência com técnicas de mineração de dados, incluindo aprendizado supervisionado e não supervisionado.
Vivência com AWS e programação em Spark/Py Spark.
Conhecimento em Airflow para orquestração de workflows.
Background em marketing digital, vendas e/ou estratégia.
Capacidade de colaborar de forma eficaz em ambientes multifuncionais e matriciais.

Conhecimento em Data Cloud:Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, resolução de identidade e segmentação no Salesforce Data Cloud.
ABM e B2 C:Experiência com estratégias de Account-Based Marketing e marketing B2 C.

Comunicação:Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.

description:

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus). Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Entregar funcionalidades, correções de bugs e melhorias na interface com atenção ao desempenho e à usabilidade. Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração, ponta a ponta). Garantir a qualidade do código e contribuir para manter uma alta cobertura de testes em toda a pilha. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto requisitos técnicos quanto de negócios. Fornecer suporte na resolução de problemas de aplicações em produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com equipes de negócios, produtos e tecnologia.

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
A Artha Growth Studio está em expansão e buscamos um(a)Editor(a) de Vídeospara integrar nosso time.Procuramos alguém com ritmo, visão estratégica de conteúdo e capacidade de transformar ideias em vídeos que geram retenção, autoridade e crescimento.A Artha Growth Studio trabalha com diferentes formatos de conteúdo, de vídeos dinâmicos para redes sociais até criativos avançados, materiais corporativos e projetos para o mercado imobiliário.Por isso, buscamos um(a)Editor(a) de Vídeoque possa atuar noestilo de edição em que mais se identifica.Você não precisa dominar tudo.Queremos pessoas que sejam muito boasno que já fazem bem.Sobre o trabalho
Você poderá atuar em diferentes tipos de projetos, como:
• Edição dinâmica de vídeos para You Tube, Reels, Shorts e Tik Tok.
• Criativos de marketing, VSL e materiais comerciais.
• Vídeos corporativos e institucionais.
• Projetos com motion, VFX ou 3 D, especialmente em conteúdos imobiliários e empreendimentos.Responsabilidades
• Edição de vídeos curtos e longos para redes sociais.
• Criação de cortes dinâmicos, legendas, transições e ritmo engajador.
• Adaptação de um vídeo-base para múltiplos formatos.
• Participação na construção da linha editorial e evolução do estilo visual da agência.
•Manter a qualidade e consistência do material da agência.
• Organização de arquivos, prazos e entregas.
•Comunicação clara com o time.
• Entrega consistente dentro dos prazos combinados.Requisitos
• Experiência no estilo de edição que deseja atuar.
• Portfólio obrigatório.
• Domínio da ferramenta que você usa.
• Capacidade de criar vídeos com alta retenção (timing, cortes, velocidade).
• Vontade real de crescer junto com a agência.Inglês e Espanhol intermediário é diferencial (trabalhamos também com clientes internacionais).Diferenciais
• Motion básico.
• Experiência com anúncios ou VSL.
• Experiência com 3 D, CGI ou VFX.Formato de trabalho
• PJ
• Remoto
• Remuneração por demanda ou mensal (dependendo da carga de projetos).

title: Front-end & ui/ux designer (webflow + wordpress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + Word Press expert who can take a website from concept to completion.About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.
Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.What You’ll DoDesign and developresponsive, visually engaging websites inWebflow and Word Press.
Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designsthat align with user needs and client goals.
Translate approved designsinto fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or Word Press.
Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
Ensure all designs followUX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/Word Press capabilities.
Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.What You Bring3+ years of professional experiencedesigning AND developing websites usingWebflow and Word Press.
A strong portfolio showcasingweb design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
Proficiency inwireframing toolsand design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
Solid understanding ofHTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
Experience withsite performance optimizationand SEO-friendly design practices.
Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.Bonus PointsExperience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.Work DetailsHours:9 A. M. – 5 P. M. MST , Monday to Friday
Requires aworking level of written and spoken EnglishIf you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.

• Promover a imagem da empresa para candidatos e prestadores de serviços externos e garantir que a Empresa é representada da forma mais precisa e apropriada para todos os candidatos e impulsiona pessoalmente os mais altos padrões de comportamento ético para todos os envolvidos nos processos de recrutamento.Se você possui:• Um ano de experiência relevante com volumetria;
• Ensino superior cursando ou completo (Administração, Psicologia ou Gestão de Recursos Humanos);
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal;
• Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, priorizar e cumprir prazos de entrega;
• Proficiência em Microsoft Office;
• Autoiniciativa, senso de urgência, trabalha bem sob pressão, capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta velocidade;
• Senso de profissionalismo e capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos;
• Grande atenção aos detalhes;
• Capacidade de lidar e manter informações confidenciais.Aqui é o seu lugar!Oque oferecemos:• Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;
• Seguro de vida;
• Plano de Saúde
• Vale-Refeição e/ou Vale-alimentação;

• Plataforma online com diversos cursos disponíveis;

title: Ai agent developer jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2 B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.
Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2 P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.Analista de Automação de IA Jr
Contratação CLTEstamos em busca de uma pessoa commão na massa e experiência prática comprovadaem ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas comoN8 N, Power Automate, APIs RESTe está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.
Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?
Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e Whats App.
Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8 N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
Aplicar IA generativa (Chat GPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.Qualificações Exigidas:
Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8 N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
Noções de bancos de dados SQL e No SQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, Mongo DB).
Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como Chat GPT.
Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.Diferenciais
Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou Whats App Business API.
Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.
Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou hackathons.
Conhecimento em documentação técnica e lógica de versionamento (ex: Read Me, Notion, Git).

title: Graphic designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!Yeah, you heard that right.Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!Key Responsibilities
Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.Qualifications
Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
Proficiency in Microsoft programs (Power Point and Word)
Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as Chat GPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
A working level of written and spoken EnglishOur operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Jde functional finance lead
description:
We’re looking for an experiencedJDE Functional Finance Leadto join our team and play a key role in supporting and optimizing JD Edwards Financial processes. This role is ideal for a hands-on finance systems professional with strong functional expertise inGL, AP, Tax, and regulatory compliance.Key Responsibilities:
Lead and supportJD Edwards (JDE) Financial modules , including GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, and Tax
Partner with Finance, Tax, Audit, and IT teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial processes
Translate business requirements intofunctional system solutions
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities

Lead testing (UAT), enhancements, and system improvements
Provide functional guidance, training, and ongoing support to finance users

Proven expertise inGeneral Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Tax

Experience leading or supporting JDE implementations or upgrades
Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business teams
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
Experience in multi-entity or multi-country financial environments
Prior experience as a functional lead or subject matter expert

title: Senior devops engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.We are currently hiring aSenior Dev Ops Engineer with AWS CDK knowledgefor an initial 12-month B2 B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and Type Script and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.Responsibilities:
Participate in our Dev Ops team
Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leadsRequirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in Dev Ops roles
Hands-on experience with Type Script and AWS CDK
Coding experience in implementing business features
Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Cloud Front, Event Bridge, App Sync, Dynamo Db, Open Search
Business-level proficiency in EnglishThe successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
Take ownership and be accountable for their work
Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
Adopt a proactive, hands-on approachWhat can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality:At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.
Problem Solving:We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Analista de treinamento vendas | salvador ba
description:
Local: Salvador – BA - (AL + BA Metropolitana + SE)
Missão
Garantir a execução da estratégia comercial no campo por meio de treinamentos , consultorias e desenvolvimento de líderes regionais . Foco em aumentar produtividade , qualidade de rota e rentabilidade das operações , conectando método, comportamento e resultado .
Principais Responsabilidades Treinamento prático de supervisores em rota, desenvolvendo liderança, aplicação de feedback e acompanhamento consistente de resultados. Consultorias presenciais e táticas nos CDs com maior risco de performance (Volume e Lucro Operacional), elaborando planos de reação e orientando a liderança local. Planejamento e execução de treinamentos mensais para SVs, GGs e equipes de vendas, abordando temas técnicos, comportamentais e estratégicos. Criação e atualização de trilhas, metodologias e materiais , traduzindo estratégia em rotina com coerência nacional e adaptação regional. Análise de KPIs e inteligência comercial aplicada , cruzando dados de execução (visitas, roteiro, mix, tempo em loja) com indicadores de resultado (HL/visita, IPC, NPS) para orientar planos de ação locais. Apoio técnico aos analistas regionais , promovendo alinhamento metodológico, padronização de entregas e consistência na aplicação das práticas de campo. Representação da área em fóruns corporativos , com protagonismo técnico em comitês de RTM, S& OP, excelência e projetos transversais com áreas parceiras.
Participação em projetos de melhoria contínua , incluindo PDCA, cronoanálises, benchmarking, testes de produtividade e pilotos em campo.
Diferenciais Forte atuação em execução comercial , treinamento e inteligência de campo . Conhecimento aplicado em PDCA, DMAIC, Lean , feedback estruturado e gestão por dados. Domínio de storytelling com dados , Power BI , Excel e apresentações executivas. Perfil com influência lateral , escuta ativa , comunicação clara e pensamento de dono . Alta disponibilidade para viagens nacionais , com atuação direta nos CDs.

title: Senior devops engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.We are currently hiring aSenior Dev Ops Engineer with AWS CDK knowledgefor an initial 12-month B2 B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and Type Script and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.Responsibilities:
Participate in our Dev Ops team
Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leadsRequirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in Dev Ops roles
Hands-on experience with Type Script and AWS CDK
Coding experience in implementing business features
Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Cloud Front, Event Bridge, App Sync, Dynamo Db, Open Search
Business-level proficiency in EnglishThe successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
Take ownership and be accountable for their work
Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
Adopt a proactive, hands-on approachWhat can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality:At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.
Problem Solving:We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Advogado tributário pleno (remuneração r$4.000)
description:
Advogado Tributário Pleno (Remuneração R$4.000)Início ImediatoQualificações:De 2 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em contencioso tributário (judicial e administrativo) em escritório de advocacia;
2 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em consultoria tributária (desejável);
Experiência em Big Four (diferencial);
Pós-graduação de Direito Tributário (diferencial);
Inscrição ativa na OAB.Principais Atividades:Atuar em demandas judiciais e administrativas tributárias e fiscais;
Analisar publicações e controlar seus respectivos prazos;
Prestar atendimento eficiente aos clientes, garantindo uma comunicação clara e transparente;
Realizar pesquisas jurídicas abrangentes para embasar estratégias de defesa;
Colaborar com colegas de equipe para desenvolver e implementar estratégias jurídicas eficazes;
Atuar na consultoria tributária envolvendo Tributos Diretos e Indiretos;
Elaborar respostas a consultas e memorandos sobre temas variados ligados ao Direito Tributário;
Avaliar regimes tributários especiais e benefícios fiscais aplicáveis;
Planejamento tributário estratégico, incluindo reorganizações societárias.Sobre o Santos Varella AdvocaciaO Santos Varella é um escritório de advocacia especializado em Direito Tributário. Com equipe de profissionais gabaritados com mais de 15 anos de excelência no mercado, atuamos na consultoria e no contencioso. Nosso diferencial está na vasta experiência de nossos profissionais, cujo histórico abrange setores jurídicos e tributários de grandes empresas multinacionais, escritórios renomados e gigantes da consultoria.

title: Partnership analyst
description:
Job DescriptionAtPluria Global , we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We providecompanies and employeeswith a disruptive solution that enables them to work fromany workspace affiliated with our network(coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users canfind and book their workspace in just one click.Unlock potential through real connections.Pluriais a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become theglobal solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations. We operate in a market growing215% in Lat Am and 55% in Colombia.At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies inreal connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to createconnected teamsthat boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.‍ We achieve this by bringing together three forces:
A network of locationsthat brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network.
Bottom-up coordination , enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals.
Top-down intelligence , delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions.This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space forconnection, collaboration, and shared growth.Some numbers that back us up:
Global presence in over10 countries
More than1,000 workspaces worldwide
20% month-over-month growth
A global team of30+ people
100% remote and multicultural teamToday, hybrid work is more a reality than ever. Data shows that66% of leadersat companies like Google, Facebook, and Microsoft are committed to redesigning office spaces into more accessible models for their employees.Harvardreports that88% of workerssay that when searching for a new role, they will look for one that offersfull flexibility in schedule and location. Additionally,90% of Millennials and Gen Z employeesdo not want to return to full-time in-office work.More detailsLink: have a challenge for those who:
Thrive on entrepreneurial energy: driven by curiosity, never give up, and constantly push their own limits.
Always give their best, valuing commitment and dedication.
Have strongcommercial, customer service, and communication skills(a plus if you’ve worked in sales).
Are eager to work in ahigh-growth startup.
Have solid Excel and Power Point skills ( data-driven mindset ).
Excel at time management and prioritization.
Possess strong logistical thinking.
Haveintermediate English - Spanish proficiency.
Are dedicated to delivering excellent customer service.
See change as an opportunity and learn from mistakes.
Value excellence and execution as core principles.
Promote a positive work environment, bringing joy and fun.
Know how to build with others and enjoy teamwork.
Are eager to gain experience incommercial and operations roles.
Can work well under pressure.
Have the ability to write and present reports.Why work at Pluria?Greater freedom to make decisions, propose initiatives, and experiment ‍
A dynamic, high-impact work environment
Frequent interaction across all levels of the company, regardless of role or title ‍‍
You’ll develop strong leadership skills—we’ll throw you into the water from day one
Learn to work with a100% international teamwhile scaling with impact
Wear multiple hats at the same time—unlike large corporations with rigid job descriptions ‍
The best MBA you could get, with steep learning curves and total freedom to execute and learn constantly
Direct exposure to founders and a top-tier tech team ‍
Imagine working onchallenging, dynamic, and innovative projectswhile being responsible for:Responsibilities – Partnership AnalystContext:Pluria operates under aB2 B model , connecting flexible workspaces and offices with the corporate sector. We use amobile appto provide companies with solutions to work from different locations such as office centers, coworking spaces, business lounges, and meeting rooms.
ThePartnerships Analystis responsible for theend-to-end processof prospecting, closing, and maintaining relationships with our partner workspaces. This role owns the full commercial cycle:attracting, activating, and retaining partners.

title: Technical lead developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. Act as the primary SPOC , coordinating resources and managing priorities across teams.
Drive service reviews, escalate issues, and ensure timely resolution for critical business processes.

Experience in debugging the code for troubleshooting the issuesWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#Buildingonbelief
